I'm excited to apply for the Platform Engineer role at Kingsley Logistics. I’ve also used Kubernetes and Terraform for production deployments and have led teams as Engineering Lead at Vertex Logistics. I thrive in remote-first environments and prefer European time zones, aligning well with your team’s setup.
